description: The subset of the 2026-11-07 sprinkler validation data (wiki/research/sprinkler-validation-data-2026-11-07.md) that tools/sprinkler-validation.mjs runs: four data sets, each with its enclosure, fire, heads and the measured activation times of the chosen tests. Every leaf is {value, source}; units are in the field names (_m, _s, _C, _kW, _m05_s05 = (m s)^1/2, _m05_per_s05 = (m/s)^1/2). The link replay records and the Evans tables used by topologicpy-web-frontend/src/core/suppression.validation.test.mjs are in topologicpy-web-frontend/src/core/suppression.validation.json, with the same notice.

vettori_flat_1998.title: Vettori flat ceiling: residential pendent heads, smooth or joisted ceiling, t-squared methane burner (NISTIR 6253)
vettori_flat_1998.licence: All sources NIST: public domain in the US (report) and NIST licence notice (repositories).
vettori_flat_1998.frame: FDS input frame: x along the 9.2 m length, y across the 5.6 m width, z up from the floor; origin at the corner where the corner burner sits (FDS Vettori_*.fds).

ceiling_height_smooth_m.source: 8 ft; NISTIR 6253 sec. 2 says 2.4 m; 2.44 m from the 0.9 m-below-ceiling TC being at '1.54 m elevation' (Tables 4-5) and FDS mesh top 2.44 m

ceiling_type.value: smooth: 12.7 mm gypsum board over the joists; obstructed: gypsum removed exposing 0.038 m x 0.24 m wood joists at 0.41 m on centre spanning the 5.6 m width (joists along y), plywood deck on top; effective floor-to-deck height 2.7 m
ceiling_type.source: NISTIR 6253 sec. 2 and 4.2; FDSIN joist OBSTs x every 0.4048 m

deck_height_m.source: FDSIN obstructed mesh top 2.64 m (report: effective height 2.7 m, sec. 4.2)

steel_I_beam.source: NISTIR 6253 sec. 2 (0.10 x 0.18 m I beam along the length, supporting the joists); position from FDSIN OBST (present in smooth and obstructed inputs). It separates heads 1-2 from heads 3-4.

value.location: x = 9.2 m wall, starting 1.6 m from the y = 0 wall (Fig. 1)

door.source: NISTIR 6253 sec. 2 and Fig. 1; CFAST inputs model it as a closed 0.91 x 2.1 m vent plus a 0.91 x 0.025 m slot

value.leads_to: upper floor of the same plan, no vent

stairwell_opening.source: NISTIR 6253 sec. 2 and Fig. 1 (0.9 x 2.7 m stair). FDSIN puts an OPEN vent there at z = 2.64 m (active only in the obstructed inputs); CFAST uses a 1.5588 m2 ceiling vent to outside

walls_floor.value: wood frame with 12.7 mm gypsum board; concrete floor

burner_size_m.source: NISTIR 6253 sec. 2.3 (0.7 x 1.0 x 0.31 m); FDS uses a 0.6 x 0.6 m HRRPUA vent on a 0.7 x 1.0 x 0.3 m block

fire_to_ceiling_m.source: NISTIR 6253 abstract (burner 2.1 m below the ceiling)

value.wall: block x 4.30-5.00, y 0-1.00 (0.7 m side on the wall)

positions.source: FDSIN OBST per position; Fig. 1 and 5 of NISTIR 6253

nominal_t_squared_alpha_kW_per_s2.source: NISTIR 6253 sec. 2.3 (1055 kW at 150, 300, 600 s); calibration Fig. 4 follows these curves

fast.source: FDSIN Vettori_SMOOTH_OPEN_FAST.fds RAMP x HRRPUA 2930 kW/m2 x 0.36 m2 burner vent (same values as FDS VG Table Vettori_Ramps and the CFAST inputs)

medium.source: FDSIN Vettori_SMOOTH_OPEN_MED.fds RAMP x HRRPUA 2930 kW/m2 x 0.36 m2 burner vent (same values as FDS VG Table Vettori_Ramps and the CFAST inputs)

slow.source: FDSIN Vettori_SMOOTH_OPEN_SLOW.fds RAMP x HRRPUA 2930 kW/m2 x 0.36 m2 burner vent (same values as FDS VG Table Vettori_Ramps and the CFAST inputs)

ramp_discrepancy.value: The FDS/CFAST tabulated ramps are about 2 to 2.5 times the nominal alpha t^2 at the activation times (fast: 196 kW vs 75 kW at 40 s; reaches 1053 kW at 100 s, not 150 s). The FDS VG calls them 'the actual heat release rate'; NISTIR 6253 gives no per-test HRR. Origin not found.
ramp_discrepancy.source: comparison of FDS VG Table Vettori_Ramps with NISTIR 6253 sec. 2.3 and Fig. 4

burner_shutoff.value: not stated in NISTIR 6253; in the companion NISTIR 7079 series gas was shut off at the first activation (2-4 s). Later activations may be after shut-off.

type.value: quick-response residential pendent, 3 mm glass bulb, one manufacturer and model

RTI_m05_s05.source: NISTIR 6253 sec. 2.2 (55 (m s)^1/2, 100 (ft s)^1/2); UL App. A: mean 55.78 frame arms perpendicular to flow, 64.29 at 25 deg; FDS inputs use 56

C_m05_per_s05.source: NISTIR 6253 App. A (UL 96NK9527): prolonged plunge at 128 C, all three samples operated at zero velocity (804, 252, 724 s), so C = 0.25 assigned per ISO 6182-1 note. FDS inputs set no C (FDS default 0).

link_below_ceiling_m.source: NISTIR 6253 sec. 2.2 and 4.2 (bulb centre 25 mm below gypsum; 37 mm below joists; 0.27 m below the deck). FDSIN places heads at z = 2.375 m in both.

flowing.source: NISTIR 6253 sec. 2.2: dry pipe with 25 ml water, air at ~100 kPa; pressure switch timed activation to +-0.1 s

positions_xy_m.source: FDSIN DEVC; NISTIR 6253 Fig. 1 (2.4 m and 4.4 m along x; 1.4 m and 2.8 m across)

head_note.value: Velocity probes only at heads 1 and 2 (25, 75, 125, 250 mm below ceiling); 12 TCs per head 0-900 mm below ceiling.

chosen.source: smooth ceiling, detached burner (data note section 9: 6-8 and 11-13; 1-3 added, the fast ramp)
